Kwia triggers, creating a Lotus token.

Activate Evereth by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, it and Liliana, Dreadhorde General trigger.
Resolve the Liliana, Dreadhorde General trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the persist creature's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.

Resolve the Sapling Nursery trigger, creating a creature token.

2921-4484-4668-4871-5643.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
Geralf's first ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie Rogue creature token.
When the Zombie Rogue enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers,  putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the Zombie Rogue equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
When Ebondeath enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio twice by sacrificing the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath.
When the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve both Bartolomé del Presidio abilities.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.
2921-4484-4668-4871-5643.notes: This combo will steadily put more +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath and the Zombie Rogue token, eventually resulting in an infinite number of them.

802-864-1170-1414--52.notablePrerequisites: You control up to two lands that can tap to produce at least {1}{U}.

You may instead bounce any creature you don't control to its owner's hand instead of bouncing the generic creature, as long as your opponents control creatures, and net one colored mana per loop.

There and Back Again has exactly two lore counters on it.

Resolve the There and Back Again trigger, putting a lore counter on it.

Resolve the Three Blind Mice trigger, putting a lore counter on it.
Three Blind Mice's second chapter ability and Sigurd trigger.
Resolve the Sigurd trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Resolve the Three Blind Mice trigger, creating a copy of the Smaug token.
Put a Smaug token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.

Activate Sigurd by paying {1}, removing a lore counter from Three Blind Mice.

At the beginning of your precombat main phase, Three Blind Mice triggers, putting a lore counter on it.
Repeat from step 7.

Repeat from step 6 for each remaining Windfall until you either draw from an empty library, causing you to win the game due to Jace, or until your opponents lose the game due to drawing from an empty library.
